caption: The drawing features a garment, specifically a cape or short cloak, depicted on a headless, armless mannequin torso. The cape is primarily colored in a deep reddish-purple with a textured shading effect to suggest fullness and material sheen. The lower edge and inner lining of the cape are trimmed with a grayish-white fur-like texture. The collar is wide and slightly upturned, and the cape is fastened at the top left side with a gray bow and ribbon detail. There is a small vertical slit near the fastening, likely for the ribbon to pass through. The underlying mannequin and the long skirt below are indicated only with light gray pencil sketches and remain uncolored. In the top right corner of the drawing, there is an additional, lightly sketched outline of the back view of the cape showing its simple layered shape and placement on the figure. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige, with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Cloak
